curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants identify a high-impact business problem and design an AI-enabled solution using strategy, product, and no-code tools. They define use cases, build a working prototype, evaluate ROI and business value, and present an implementation roadmap covering adoption, risks, and scalability, demonstrating how AI can drive measurable outcomes in real organizational contexts.

content.title: Do I need to have prior Generative AI experience to enroll in the program?
content: This program is specifically crafted for mid-level professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with foundational industry experience.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: Any latest processor (i3/i5/i7) with 2.0GHz clock speed and RAM 4GB (required), 8GB(recommended).

content.title: How much time does one need to spend?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 4 Months.

points.title: Why SP Jain School of Global Management

content.title: How is the SP Jain's Generative AI program different?
content: ### This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Innovative Learning at SP Jain:** Ranked #7 in Asia Pacific by Bloomberg Businessweek, SP Jain School of Global Management emphasizes a blend of advanced theoretical learning with practical business applications, preparing graduates for leadership roles.

- **Practical Application and Global Perspective:** SP Jain focuses on transforming theory into actionable strategies. The curriculum fosters global thinking and local implementation, equipping students to make significant impacts in their industries.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
